breaking_news.headline: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

breaking_news.headline: California Attorney General Bonta says states made demands in Paramount-Warner deal
breaking_news.summary: The settlement brings a two-month legal fight over Paramount's Warner Bros. Discovery takeover closer to an end.

breaking_news.headline: A journalist once barred from the White House says this media ban is different
breaking_news.summary: Jim Acosta has already been through a White House press-pass fight. Now, three news organizations are barred, and he says the press is showing solidarity that should have come sooner.

breaking_news.headline: How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms
breaking_news.summary: Critics say a slowdown of AI development among the largest companies could consolidate the power of frontier labs, just as many others are trying to catch up.

breaking_news.headline: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
breaking_news.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
breaking_news.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

breaking_news.headline: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
breaking_news.summary: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

breaking_news.headline: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
breaking_news.summary: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

breaking_news.headline: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
breaking_news.summary: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.

breaking_news.headline: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace
breaking_news.summary: Poland says the aircraft stayed in its skies for 42 seconds, forcing the Nato member to scramble its fighter jets.

breaking_news.headline: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
breaking_news.summary: Assault survivor Miriam Haley said the "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".

breaking_news.headline: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
breaking_news.summary: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

breaking_news.headline: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
breaking_news.summary: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

breaking_news.headline: White House rolling out red carpet for historic Xi Jinping visit
breaking_news.summary: Trump and Xi are expected to discuss a range of issues from trade to AI during the latter's multi-day visit to Washington.

breaking_news.headline: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
breaking_news.summary: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

breaking_news.headline: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
breaking_news.summary: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants AI to be rebranded as super intelligence. Will it work?
breaking_news.summary: Some people close to the president have started to use the term but experts say it is unlikely to catch on.

breaking_news.headline: Europe's car makers are in crisis. Will the threat of war rescue them?
breaking_news.summary: Auto executives across Europe hope rearmament can help them flex their industrial muscles once more.

breaking_news.headline: Will a switch to light speed cut power use at data centres?
breaking_news.summary: To save power and add capacity,  data centres are switching from copper wires to tech using light.

breaking_news.headline: Bentley unveils its first fully electric car
breaking_news.summary: The SUVs will be built on a new production line in Crewe, which has been Bentley's base since 1946.
